motions.title: The 63 SKELETON modules each get a verdict by the same differential rule -- no port without proof
motions.description: The 63 modules phase-0 marked SKELETON have never been classified. The campaign's own rule applies: a module is ported only when its pure logic exists AND it arrives with (a) a wired consumer, (b) a per-function sha256 receipt plus a call proof, (c) a differential test that is RED on the pre-port tree. Each of the 63 gets one verdict -- port (pure logic exists) or host-side (I/O-bound) -- with evidence, never by assertion. A module with no pure logic is HOST-SIDE, not a gap to invent work for.
